name: Worthiness Benchmark
description: A proposed benchmark/framework for analyzing and comparing the behavior and reliability of binary classification evaluation metrics under varied conditions.
reputation: A research/framework proposal with limited practical adoption to date, primarily discussed in academic evaluation circles.
notes: Framework paper (not a fixed dataset); focuses on analyzing properties of binary classification metrics under varied conditions — not an LLM benchmark. Useful for simulation studies; risk of limited reproducibility if synthetic scenarios are not well specified.
